title: Wings: Learning Multimodal LLMs without Text-only Forgetting

layout.note: Three columns without outer frames: two stacked chat cards on the left, the radar chart with its title and legend in the centre, two stacked chat cards on the right; one watermelon photo overlaps the corner of the lower right card.

lesson: Show behaviour and score in one teaser: chat cards on both sides, headed by coloured highlighter labels for the input types, around a central radar chart; set key words of the model reply on solid green so the reader sees what it got right.
